visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Clock Advances a Full Quantum Every Time
visualizerParams.problemDescription: P1 should finish at time 10, but the program says 12 because the clock moves too far when a process needs less than a full quantum.

solution.explanation: A process that needs less than the quantum leaves the CPU early, so the clock must advance only by the time it actually used (slice). Adding the whole quantum every time makes later finish times too late.

tests.pattern: (?<![\s\S])\s*P3 finishes at 6[ \t]*\r?\nP2 finishes at 9[ \t]*\r?\nP1 finishes at 10\s*(?![\s\S])
